verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions provides GitHub-Actions-compatible CI/CD workflows (gitea-docs-2, gitea-docs-15), and the product lists Kubernetes AutoScaling Runners (gitea-docs-31), which implies runners the customer operates. The managed offering (gitea-docs-22, gitea-docs-32) hosts the Gitea environment, but nothing says it includes platform-hosted runners. Missing for 10: explicit platform-hosted runner offering, documented private runner registration and management, centralized runner/pipeline visibility dashboard, independent hands-on corroboration.
